responsibility: This implementation module provides the gm2 runtime event/interrupt dispatcher used by coroutine-style code. It represents interrupt vectors for file-descriptor input, file-descriptor output, and timers; tracks active and pending vectors by COROUTINES protection priority; uses RTco semaphores for synchronization and Selective/select-based waiting for readiness or timeout expiry; and dispatches pending vectors through a caller-supplied callback. It is the runtime bridge between coroutine priorities and OS-level readiness/timer events.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the dispatcher implementation for the RTint pair: unlike RTint.def, it defines the interrupt vector data structures, priority-indexed pending lists, synchronization with RTco semaphores, timer bookkeeping, and Selective/select integration used by Listen.
